svg.title: Gatehall of Shells — Open shell-rib gate pavilions above canal locks
svg.desc: An open shell-rib arch crowns the canal gate. A reefguard booth and bronze sluice gantry branch toward the barracks and cistern; piled decks continue to Pearl Hall.
svg.text: Open shell-rib gate pavilions above canal locks
An open shell-rib arch crowns the canal gate. A reefguard booth and bronze sluice gantry branch toward the
barracks and cistern; piled decks continue to Pearl Hall.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
P1 Tidal Gate Causeway · P2 Cistern Works · P3 Pearl Hall · P4 Reefguard Barracks
